title: 2026 UK ETS free-allocation standalone ALR workflow QA controls

sources.publisher: Environment Agency and UK ETS regulators
sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for installations: how to comply

facts.source_fact: Installations in the Allocation Table must submit an activity level report.
Activity level data must be accompanied by a verification report.
The ALR covers activity level of each sub-installation.
31 March is the annual ALR and verification-report deadline in the installation guidance.
From 2026 ALRs use a separate standalone METS workflow rather than the AER workflow.
Free-allocation installations must complete both ALR and AER reporting tasks by the applicable deadline.
facts.expected_handling: Do not merge the two reporting obligations.

facts.source_fact: The ALR is prepared using the official ALR template.
The ALR must accord with the Activity Level Changes Regulation.
A submitted ALR is a compliance report, not a parcel-level emissions value.
